summary: Make usage cost probes independent of generated-store age and record their existing growth debt

replay.detail: Test fixture only; no replay or runtime source change.

schema.detail: No production database, index or migration change.

rules.detail: The default 3x growth rule, slack and every other route limit remain unchanged. The two usage routes have an explicit 8.9x known-growth debt bound derived from the retained measurements; no production cost saving is claimed.

compatibility.detail: No client, claim or API behavior changes. Cost probes pass explicit shared period bounds after the synthetic usage history so cache age cannot change the answer-normalized verdict.

downtime.detail: No deployment or startup behavior changes.

manual.detail: No manual migration or configuration change.

recovery.detail: No persisted production state changes; reverting restores the prior cost fixture.
